title: Do Audio LLMs Really LISTEN, or Just Transcribe? Measuring Lexical vs. Acoustic Emotion Cues Reliance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating audio language models on the LISTEN benchmark across four controlled conditions (Neutral-Text, Emotion-Matched, Emotion-Mismatched, and Paralinguistic) and three input modalities (Text-only, Audio-only, and Text+Audio) to measure the models' overreliance on textual transcripts versus genuine acoustic and prosodic emotion cues.
